item.title: I'm a human doctor with human intelligence. But I sure do like my AI notetaker
item.description: Has your doctor asked whether they can use artificial intelligence to take notes during an exam? It's very popular, and here's how to think through the pros and the cons of the new technology.
item.content:encoded: Has your doctor asked whether they can use artificial intelligence to take notes during an exam? It's very popular, and here's how to think through the pros and the cons of the new technology.
item.dc:creator: Mara Gordon

item.title: Does locking up a student's cell phone improve test scores? A new study suggests so
item.description: A new study of school cellphone bans finds they may help students make up for some of the learning they've lost since 2013 – a divergence from earlier study results.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Nvidia scandal and CEO's resignation rock Silicon Valley
item.description: Some in Silicon Valley are calling for former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to get his job back after he resigned amid reports of affairs with an alleged Chinese spy.

item.title: California sues OpenAI over hacking risks
item.description: The state's attorney general started investigating OpenAI after the Hugging Face attack and now says this attack was "entirely foreseeable" due to OpenAI's poor security practices.

item.title: U.S. tightens controls on remote access to AI technology amid Nvidia fallout
item.description: The new rule closes a loophole that existed that allowed Chinese companies to still access advanced AI chips remotely, despite U.S. restrictions on their physical sale to China.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: U.N. talks seek to rein in 'killer robots' as fears over AI weapons grow
item.description: Countries are meeting in Geneva to negotiate rules on weapons that can select and kill targets without human intervention. But with the U.S., Russia and Israel resisting legally binding controls, campaigners fear the window to act is closing.

item.title: It's not just the U.S., the movement against data centers is global
item.description: Activists protesting data centers in their backyards are teaming up to learn tactics from allies around the world. "We are coordinated and we are together," said one Spanish activist.

item.title: How the tech industry and markets have responded to Jensen Huang's resignation
item.description: We look at the industry and market response to news that NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang was forced to step down after reports of affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and two of his employees.
